config.label: 0x-prefixed 32-byte EVM private key for the wallet that pays for hyperD calls in USDC on Base
config.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte EVM private key for the wallet that pays for hyperD calls in USDC on Base. The wallet must hold USDC (~$5 is plenty for hundreds of decision cycles). The MCP server signs EIP-3009 transfer authorizations per call.
